Here is the weekly ASX X thread for the week of 24 August 2026:

Post 1

ASX closed at 8,847pts last week. The question this week: can materials hold the line while rate-cut hopes keep financials bid? Mixed stance — two sectors pulling in opposite directions makes conviction expensive here. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

⛏️ Miners face iron ore at USD 98/t — any move through USD 100/t flips sentiment fast. 🏦 Banks watch for RBA minutes Tuesday; a dovish tilt could reprice the big four before Friday. #mining #ironore #banking #RBA #ASX

Post 3

Watch BHP this week. Iron ore hovering near USD 98/t means every dollar of spot movement is roughly 1.5% on earnings estimates. A break either side sets the tone for the whole materials complex. #BHP #mining #ironore #ASX

Post 4

S&P 500 closed at 5,612pts Friday. US Fed speakers this week at Jackson Hole carry the real risk — any hawkish tilt tightens global risk appetite and hits ASX resource and growth names hardest. #ASX #Fed #ausbiz #inflation

Post 5

Jackson Hole keynote Friday is the week's pin risk. Market prices one Fed cut by Dec. A hawkish surprise lifts USD, pressures AUD, and sells off ASX rate-sensitives. A dovish lean does the opposite. Which way are you positioned? #Fed #RBA #ASX #ausbiz

Post 1

⛏️ Uranium lit up the ASX on Monday. The index added 44.20pts to close at 9,103.10 (+0.49%), but the real story was nuclear names surging while health insurers and telcos bled out. Two markets in one session. #ASX #uranium #ausbiz

Post 2

🔺 Materials led all sectors at +2.43%, dragging the index higher. IT added +0.97%. On the other side, Consumer Staples fell -0.95% and Financials slipped -0.72%. Rotation, not a broad rally. #ASX #materials #ausbiz

Post 3

DTL surged +17.85% to AUD 11.09 — the top performer in the ASX 200 today. Meanwhile NIB Holdings dropped -9.05% to AUD 6.73, the session's sharpest fall. Results-driven divergence doing the heavy lifting. #ASX #healthcare #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,488.80/oz. Silver AUD 96.88/oz. Platinum AUD 2,719.07/oz. With AUD/USD at 0.7159, the metals complex in local terms remains elevated — a tailwind keeping Materials bid. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5

ASX sits 2.08% off its 52-week high with a 5-day gain of just 0.33%. Can uranium momentum and gold above AUD 6,400 close that gap? Bulls need Materials to hold. Where do you see the index by Friday? #ASX #ausbiz #uranium
